author: Telos I
title: AOS Admin: Update Task Statuses Post-Verification
abstract: Updating the AOS task list following the successful verification of the experiment manager. Task 17 (bug fix) is being marked as 'completed', and Task 18 (station review) is being set to 'active'.

original_submission.content:
import subprocess
import sys

# --- Configuration ---
UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH = "storage/telos/update_task.py"
TASKS_TO_UPDATE = {
    17: "completed", # Debug and verify experiment_manager.py bug
    18: "active"     # Systematically Review Station Resources
}

# --- Execution ---
print("--- Updating AOS Task Statuses ---")
success_count = 0
for task_id, new_status in TASKS_TO_UPDATE.items():
    command = ["python", UPDATE_SCRIPT_PATH, str(task_id), new_status]
    try:
        result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        print(f"Update for Task ID {task_id}:")
        print(result.stdout.strip())
        success_count += 1
    except subprocess.CalledProcessError as e:
        print(f"Error updating Task ID {task_id}:")
        print(e.stdout)
        print(e.stderr)

print(f"--- Sequence Complete: {success_count}/{len(TASKS_TO_UPDATE)} updates successful. ---")
